name: Tulimoa
tagline: Tulimoa is a free, hand-curated directory for small and innovative SaaS tools
description: Tulimoa is a free, hand-curated directory for small and innovative SaaS tools. Every listing is manually reviewed within roughly 24 hours and published with a do-follow backlink. There is no pay-to-rank, no listing fee, and no SEO-farm mentality. The directory is built for the tools that lack the marketing budget for the larger software catalogs but still deserve reach.
